text: Evaluate the qualities required for a successful government. [30]
‘There should be more acknowledgement of women’s involvement in sport.’ To what extent do you
agree? [30]
‘The main responsibility for health education lies with schools.’ To what extent do you agree? [30]
Examine how young people can be inspired to become scientists and mathematicians in your
country. [30]
‘Medical research should only be concerned with finding cures for the world’s deadliest diseases.’
To what extent do you agree?
‘Genetically modified food is the only solution to world hunger.’ Discuss.
‘Blogs are the most reliable source of information.’ Discuss.
‘As the world becomes more of a global community, it is important to preserve traditional cultures
in your country.’ To what extent do you agree? [30]
To what extent do you agree that films, literature or paintings can only reflect the real world? [30]
‘This music captures the times we live in.’ Evaluate whether the music you listen to does this. [30]
